title: Automatic Cat Feeder,4L Timed Cat＆Dog Dry Food Dispenser
say: Customers find the automatic feeder works well and is easy to set up and use, with the ability to program different feeding times and amounts. They appreciate its battery backup feature and consider it worth the price. The portion size receives mixed feedback - while some find the portion sizes perfect, others say they are way off. The reliability aspect is also mixed, with some reporting it works well for several years while others experienced malfunctions.
